skips.coverageStatement: HONEST COST, stated because a count alone would hide it: on Windows the real macOS seatbelt confinement is not exercised. That covers SEC-7 sandbox conformance, the no-keychain/DEK-reach contract, and the KgEmbed/KgGenerate runtime fail-closed proofs. These are security-relevant properties that now have NO real-confinement coverage on the machine the gates run on. The structured non-darwin assertions in the same files still run, so the membrane wiring is still proven; the confinement itself is not. This is a coverage hole created by the host move, not by any source change, and it is recorded here rather than absorbed into a skip count.
